brief:
Widows in Gaza face mounting hardship as displacement from the conflict leaves them isolated and struggling to survive, Al Jazeera English reported. Stripped of breadwinners and support systems, these women confront daily challenges securing food, shelter, and basic necessities in tent camps across the territory.

The widows carry the compounded trauma of bereavement alongside the practical crises of displacement. Without stable incomes or family structures, they navigate insecurity and poverty while managing the psychological toll of war-related loss, with few resources or social safety nets available to help them rebuild their lives.
dek: Widows in Gaza struggle alone under displacement, burdened by loss, insecurity, and daily battles for survival.
title: Gaza widows battle alone amid displacement and loss
